sources.citation: Umaraj, K. 2022. Negations in Mullukurumba and Kattunaikka Tribes in Nilgiris. International Journal of Trend in Scientific Research and Development 6(5): 2103-2107.
sources.note: Nothing; negation morphology only. Cites Joseph 1982 as its descriptive source.

sources.citation: KIRTADS (Pugazhendi, P. & Suresh, K.P.). 2020. Visual Documentation of Tangible and Intangible Heritage of ST Communities in Kerala: Mullukuruman. Kozhikode: KIRTADS (Malayalam).

sources.citation: Nair, Ravi Sankar S. 2013. Tribal Languages of Kerala. Language in India 13(7): 1-58; Mullu Kurumba section pp. 54-57.
sources.note: Nothing. The Mullu Kurumba section is a morphology-only sketch (gender/number, case, pronouns, tense, participles, pronominal suffixes) drawn from Joseph 1982; no phonology and no mention of stress or accent.

sources.citation: Glottolog 5.3 languoid page for mull1244 and its 10 BibTeX reference records (Joseph 1982; Menon 1996; Luiz 1962; Nambiar 1964; Ramaiah & Reddy 2005; Shortt 1868; Nair 2013; Sathianathan 1993; Misra 1971; Fürer-Haimendorf 1952).
sources.note: Nothing. Apart from Joseph 1982 all entries are ethnographic, overview or bibliographical; Luiz 1962 calls the speech 'an unintelligible dialect of Kanarese' with Tamil/Malayalam admixture (no phonetic content).
